name: ai-gst
description: Anguilla General Services Tax (GST) for ordinary domestic taxable services in 2026, under the General Services Tax Act, 2025 (in force 1 August 2025). Covers the registration tests (XCD 300,000 actual or expected), the 13% rate, tax-exclusive and tax-inclusive invoice arithmetic (13/113), supported input credits and the s 25 apportionment, monthly returns due on the 20th, payment, records, and the IRD return lines. Use for Anguilla GST, service invoices, taxable turnover, GST registration or inp
author: openaccountants
